# Ella Tech Solutions

> Ella Tech Solutions is a Detroit-based web design and local SEO firm. It builds mobile-friendly websites and runs the local SEO and AEO (AI answer engine optimization) work that helps local service businesses such as plumbers, HVAC, auto repair, towing, and salons get found on Google and recommended by AI tools like ChatGPT. Founded by Steven Bowman. Serves clients nationwide. Also provides CRM setup, Microsoft 365 implementation, AI workflow integration, staff training, and LMS development.

## Plans and Pricing

- **Get Found**: $1,200 to $1,800 up front plus $150 a month. Mobile-friendly website, optimized Google Business Profile, local SEO foundation (location pages, listings, structured data).
- **Get Called**: $2,200 to $3,500 up front plus $275 a month. Everything in Get Found plus expanded local SEO, AEO so AI tools surface the business, and review generation strategy.
- **Own the Area**: $3,500 to $5,500 up front plus $450 to $500 a month. Everything in Get Called plus ongoing content, competitor monitoring and rank tracking, and monthly reporting.

Guarantee: if the site and Google Business Profile are not live within 2 weeks of the client providing content, the client gets a free month of monitoring.

Book a free 30-minute consultation: https://cal.com/ella-tech-7ze7wk or call (313) 474-1772.

## Who We Serve

**Primary:** Local, service-based businesses that depend on nearby customers finding them and calling.

**Also:** Nonprofits with annual budgets between $500,000 and $5 million (mission-driven pricing available for verified 501(c)(3) organizations) and small businesses needing CRM, Microsoft 365, AI workflow, or training help.

**Not served:** Schools, K-12 programs, and school districts.

## Additional Services

- [Website Creation and Redesign](https://www.ellatechsolutions.com/services/website-design): Custom websites for nonprofits and small businesses, 4 to 8 weeks, responsive design, donation and lead-capture integration, post-launch training included.
- [CRM Strategy and Setup](https://www.ellatechsolutions.com/services/crm-setup): Platform selection, configuration, data migration, and staff training for Salesforce NPSP, HubSpot, Bloomerang, and similar tools.
- [AI Workflow Integration and AI Literacy Training](https://www.ellatechsolutions.com/services/ai-workflow): Workflow audit, automation implementation using existing tools, and practical AI literacy training for staff with no technical background.
- [Staff Technology Training](https://www.ellatechsolutions.com/services/staff-training): Live and self-paced training on tools organizations already use, in plain language without assuming a technical background.
- [LMS and Microlearning Development](https://www.ellatechsolutions.com/services/lms-development): LMS platform selection and implementation, SCORM-compliant course development in Articulate 360, administrator training.
- [Microsoft 365 Implementation](https://www.ellatechsolutions.com/services/microsoft-365): Business email, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive setup with permissions configuration and staff training.
- [Paid Digital Strategy Sessions](https://www.ellatechsolutions.com/services/digital-strategy): Focused 30-to-60 minute consultation delivering a technology audit and prioritized action plan, no long-term commitment required.

## About the Founder

Steven Bowman founded Ella Tech Solutions after approximately 15 years as an IT leader and program director inside nonprofits and large organizations across Michigan. He serves as CTO of Ella Tech Solutions, delivering technology strategy and implementation directly to nonprofits and small businesses across the United States.
